11.
Section 128A of the principal enactment is hereby
amended by the repeal of subsection (3) and the substitution
therefor of the following :-
“(3) The Minister may prescribe by regulations
the requirements, qualifications and tests necessary
to qualify for an endorsement on a Driving Licence
authorizing a Licence holder to drive an emergency
service vehicle or public service vehicle, as the case
may be.”.
